entities.summary: Oleksandra Denysivna Oliynykova is a Ukrainian professional tennis player. She has career-high rankings of world No. 66 in singles, achieved on 16 March 2026, and No. 663 in doubles, achieved on 6 May 2024. She has won three WTA 125 singles titles as well as 10 singles and two doubles titles on the ITF Women's Circuit.
